description: The Scaly entry's server behind an nginx edge: nginx terminates TLS and HTTP/2 and serves the static files, the Scaly http package answers the dynamic routes over HTTP/1.1. In production-stack it keeps its items and users cache-aside in an in-process L1 shared by every scheduler thread (a sequence lock per slot, reads without a lock) over Postgres; nginx's own split, reuseport listeners on the loopback addresses.
